x: Bert won the VAC 5 mile road race in June, his first Championship win, and achieved the fifth fastest time in the South of England relay at Aldershot, faster than Bob Belmore and Derek Wood of Barnet.
M60: 1, L.O'Hara (Belgrave) 28:16; 2, R.Higgs (Barnet) 29:24; 3, D.Thomas (Cambridge H) 31:16; 4, A.Stroud 31:17; 5, C.Walker 31:42; 7, P.Newell 31:59.
Perhaps we could get revenge for the National defeat by Barnet in May, but it was not to be. Again the Barnet four all ran better than recent form would have suggested.

The Belgrave over sixties stars won back the South of England title they lost last year to Barnet, but it was a pretty close thing with Laurie O'Hara outsprinting Ron Higgs in the final straight winning by a mere six seconds.
